setting.app_icon.label: App icon
setting.app_icon.tip: The icon on the window, the taskbar and the system tray. It changes nothing in your videos or photos.
setting.area_fraction.label: Box size limits
setting.area_fraction.tip: Ignore or adjust boxes smaller or larger than this share of the frame.
setting.area_safety.label: Box padding
setting.area_safety.tip: Grow each box by this fraction of its size so edges stay covered.
setting.art_style.label: Art style
setting.art_style.tip: How the figures on the what-to-hide screen are drawn. It changes nothing in your videos or photos.
setting.aspect_ratio.label: Box shape limits
setting.aspect_ratio.tip: Ignore or adjust boxes whose width-to-height ratio is outside this range.
setting.blur_approximation_min_kernel.ti: Blurs at least this large are computed at reduced resolution.
setting.blur_edge_margin.label: Blur reads past the box
setting.blur_edge_margin.tip: Blur uses real pixels around the box, so it stays steady as the box resizes.
setting.blur_fast_approximation.label: Fast heavy blur
setting.blur_fast_approximation.tip: Compute heavy blurs at reduced resolution. Faster, and looks the same.
setting.candidate_floor.label: Candidate floor
setting.candidate_floor.tip: Detections scoring below this are dropped before overlap removal.
setting.catalog_scan_interval_seconds.ti: Seconds between looks at the watched folders for new, moved or removed videos. 0 looks only when you ask.
setting.censor_overlap_strategy.label: Overlap handling
setting.censor_overlap_strategy.tip: How overlapping boxes of one style are drawn: separately, in one pass, or merged into one span.
setting.censor_scale_strategy.label: Style scaling
setting.censor_scale_strategy.tip: Scale style strength to the box, to the whole image, or not at all.
setting.censor_shape.label: Shape
setting.censor_shape.tip: The outline of the censored area: box, circle or ellipse.
setting.censor_style.label: Look
setting.censor_style.tip: How this body part is hidden. A list picks one style per appearance, by weight.
setting.class_promotion.label: Label promotion
setting.class_promotion.tip: Relabel a detection when other evidence overlaps it, such as covered to exposed.
setting.class_suppression.label: Label suppression
setting.class_suppression.tip: Drop a detection when a more confident, overlapping label contradicts it.
setting.class_suppression_refused.label: Never-proposed pairs
setting.class_suppression_refused.tip: Label pairs the suppression tool should never suggest as rules.
setting.confirm_score.label: Confirm score
setting.confirm_score.tip: A new track shows before reaching the minimum hits once one detection scores this high.
setting.console_color.label: Terminal color
setting.console_color.tip: Color in terminal output: automatic, always or never.
setting.console_level.label: Terminal detail
setting.console_level.tip: The least important message shown in the terminal.
setting.console_palette.label: Terminal palette
setting.console_palette.tip: Color palette for terminal output, including color-vision-friendly ones.
setting.cross_size_dedup_enabled.label: Merge duplicate sizes
setting.cross_size_dedup_enabled.tip: Merge detections of one object found at more than one detection size.
setting.cross_size_dedup_iou.label: Duplicate overlap
setting.cross_size_dedup_iou.tip: How much two boxes must overlap to count as the same object.
setting.cuda_device_id.label: GPU number
setting.cuda_device_id.tip: Which GPU to use, starting at 0.
setting.debug_mode.label: Debug mode
setting.debug_mode.tip: 0 off, 1 draws labeled boxes, 3 also saves debug output.
setting.detection_checkpoint_frames.tip: Save detection progress every this many frames, so a stopped run resumes. 0 turns it off.
setting.detection_prefetch_frames.label: Frames decoded ahead
setting.detection_prefetch_frames.tip: Frames decoded ahead of the model to keep it busy. 0 turns it off.
setting.detector_backend.label: Detection model
setting.detector_backend.tip: The model that finds body parts in each frame.
setting.enable_betasuite_watermark.label: Watermark
setting.enable_betasuite_watermark.tip: Add a small BetaSuite mark to the output.
setting.encode_crf.label: Quality
setting.encode_crf.tip: Lower is better quality and larger files. 17 is close to the source.
setting.encode_preset.label: Encode speed
setting.encode_preset.tip: Slower presets make smaller files at the same quality.
setting.encode_video_codec.label: Video encoder
setting.encode_video_codec.tip: The ffmpeg encoder for the finished video, such as libx264 or h264_nvenc.
setting.ffmpeg_max_retries.label: Encoder retries
setting.ffmpeg_max_retries.tip: Times to retry a failed ffmpeg step.
setting.ffmpeg_retry_backoff_seconds.tip: Seconds to wait before retrying a failed ffmpeg step.
setting.force_structure_profile.label: Video type for every file
setting.force_structure_profile.none: Each video chooses its own type
setting.force_structure_profile.tip: Use one video type for every file instead of choosing per file.
setting.geometry_action.label: When a box breaks a limit
setting.geometry_action.tip: Drop the box, clamp it to the limit, or only flag it.
setting.global_min_prob.label: Detection floor
setting.global_min_prob.tip: Every detection scoring below this is discarded first.
setting.gpu_enabled.label: Use the GPU
setting.gpu_enabled.tip: Run detection on the graphics card.
setting.cache_dir.label: Cache folder
setting.cache_dir.tip: Where detections, transcodes and thumbnails are kept. Takes effect when the app restarts.
setting.storage_delete_permanently.label: Delete for good when clearing storage
setting.storage_delete_permanently.tip: Clearing in the Storage view removes files for good instead of moving them to the trash.
setting.governor_enabled.label: Slow down when the computer needs it
setting.governor_enabled.tip: Ease off when memory is short, on battery or the computer is busy. Off is full speed, unless memory runs very low.
setting.governor_memory_pressure_pct.tip: How much of the time, in percent, programs may wait for memory before render workers are cut. Linux only.
setting.governor_memory_severe_pct.label: Severe memory pressure threshold
setting.governor_memory_severe_pct.tip: Memory waiting time, in percent, at which only one render worker runs. Linux only.
setting.governor_busy_cpu_pct.label: Busy computer threshold
setting.governor_busy_cpu_pct.tip: Other programs' processor use, in percent of all cores, above which the run lowers its priority.
setting.governor_user_idle_seconds.label: Active user window
setting.governor_user_idle_seconds.tip: Seconds since the last key or mouse input that still count as someone using the computer. Windows only.
setting.governor_battery_low_pct.label: Low battery threshold
setting.governor_battery_low_pct.tip: Battery charge, in percent, below which only one render worker runs.
setting.governor_detection_pace_max.tip: The largest share of a file's detection time that yielding to other programs may add.
setting.interpolation_enabled.label: Fill short gaps
setting.interpolation_enabled.tip: Keep a box in place through short gaps between detections.
setting.interpolation_max_gap.label: Longest gap filled
setting.interpolation_max_gap.tip: The longest gap, in seconds, a box is carried across. Unless set, track memory is at least this long.
setting.items_to_censor.label: What to hide
setting.log_level.label: Log file detail
setting.log_level.tip: The least important message written to the log file.
setting.log_path.label: Log file
setting.log_path.tip: Where the log file is written.
setting.logging_enabled.label: Write a log file
setting.logging_enabled.tip: Keep a log file of each run.
setting.match_distance_multiplier.label: Match distance
setting.match_distance_multiplier.tip: How far a box may move between frames and still be the same track.
setting.min_prob.label: Minimum confidence
setting.min_prob.tip: Detections of this body part below this score are ignored.
setting.min_prob_continue.label: Keep-tracking confidence
setting.min_prob_continue.tip: A lower score that keeps an existing track alive.
setting.min_track_hits.label: Detections before showing
setting.min_track_hits.tip: How many detections a new track needs before it is censored.
setting.model_path.label: Model file
setting.model_path.tip: The model file for this detector.
setting.model_variant.label: Model size
setting.model_variant.tip: A larger model finds more, more slowly.
setting.move_completed_sources.label: Move finished sources
setting.move_completed_sources.tip: Move each finished source file into a completed folder.
setting.native_size.label: Model input size
setting.native_size.tip: The size the model file was exported at.
setting.nms_iou.label: Overlap removal
setting.nms_iou.tip: How much two detections must overlap before the weaker is removed.
setting.nms_mode.label: Overlap removal mode
setting.nms_mode.tip: Remove overlaps within each label, or across all labels.
setting.nn_batch_size.label: Batch size
setting.nn_batch_size.tip: Frames sent to the model at once. Changes speed and memory, never results.
setting.paired_style.label: Matching pairs
setting.paired_style.tip: Give two nearby tracks of this part the same look.
setting.paired_style_max_age.label: Pair memory
setting.paired_style_max_age.tip: Seconds a missing track can still lend its look to its pair.
setting.paired_style_max_distance.label: Pair distance
setting.paired_style_max_distance.tip: How far apart two tracks can be and still pair.
setting.paired_style_tiebreak_margin.tip: How much closer one candidate must be to win the pairing.
setting.person_backend.label: Person model
setting.person_backend.tip: The model that outlines whole people for reverse mode.
setting.person_batch_size.label: Person batch size
setting.person_batch_size.tip: Frames sent to the person model at once.
setting.person_min_prob.label: Person confidence
setting.person_min_prob.tip: People found below this score are ignored.
setting.person_model_path.label: Person model file
setting.person_model_path.tip: The model file for this person model.
setting.person_model_variant.label: Person model size
setting.person_model_variant.tip: A larger person model outlines better, more slowly.
setting.person_nms_iou.label: Person overlap removal
setting.person_nms_iou.tip: How much two people must overlap before the weaker is removed.
setting.person_picture_size.label: Person model input size
setting.person_picture_size.tip: The image size the person model sees.
setting.person_windows_enabled.label: Whole male bodies
setting.person_windows_enabled.tip: In reverse mode, show whole male bodies from person outlines.
setting.person_windows_evidence_min_prob: A label inside an outline counts as evidence above this score.
setting.person_windows_female_labels.tip: Labels that mark an outlined person as female.
setting.person_windows_male_labels.label: Male evidence
setting.person_windows_male_labels.tip: Labels that mark an outlined person as male.
setting.person_windows_shrink.label: Outline trim
setting.person_windows_shrink.tip: Trim this share of the person outline off its edge.
setting.person_windows_track_iou.label: Person tracking overlap
setting.person_windows_track_iou.tip: How much an outline must overlap to continue a person track.
setting.person_windows_track_max_gap_sec: Seconds a person may go unseen and keep their track.
setting.picture_sizes.label: Detection size
setting.picture_sizes.tip: The image size the model sees. Usually the model's own size.
setting.position_smoothing.label: Position smoothing
setting.position_smoothing.tip: Lower is smoother, higher follows movement more closely.
setting.preview_encode_preset.label: Preview encode speed
setting.preview_encode_preset.tip: Encoder preset for previews. Faster is fine for a check.
setting.preview_max_seconds.label: Preview length
setting.preview_max_seconds.tip: Seconds of video in a preview.
setting.preview_mode_enabled.label: Preview only
setting.preview_mode_enabled.tip: Render a short slice instead of the whole video.
setting.preview_random_slice.label: Random preview slice
setting.preview_random_slice.tip: Take the preview from a random point in the video.
setting.preview_start_seconds.label: Preview start
setting.preview_start_seconds.tip: Where in the video the preview starts, in seconds.
setting.profile_by_path_pattern.label: Video type by path
setting.profile_by_path_pattern.tip: File patterns that choose a video type, checked before folders.
setting.profile_by_source_dir.label: Video type by folder
setting.profile_by_source_dir.tip: Source folders whose videos get a given video type.
setting.profile_default.label: Default video type
setting.profile_default.tip: The video type used when none matches.
setting.profile_enabled.label: Video types
setting.profile_enabled.tip: Choose timing per video by its type.
setting.profile_manual_only.label: Manual only
setting.profile_manual_only.tip: This video type is never chosen automatically.
setting.profile_match_on.label: Video type signal
setting.profile_match_on.tip: The measurement that chooses a video type automatically.
setting.profile_min_cuts_per_min.label: Cuts per minute
setting.profile_min_cuts_per_min.tip: Videos with at least this many cuts per minute get this type.
Videos with at least this share of short shots get this type.
setting.profile_video_censor_fps.label: Sample rate for this type
setting.profile_video_censor_fps.tip: Frames per second checked for videos of this type.
setting.render_chunk_container.label: Chunk container
setting.render_chunk_container.tip: The container for render chunks before joining.
setting.render_chunk_seconds.label: Chunk length
setting.render_chunk_seconds.tip: Seconds of video per render chunk. 0 renders in one piece.
setting.render_decode_threads.label: Decode threads
setting.render_decode_threads.tip: Decode threads per render worker. 0 shares the cores out.
setting.render_memory_reserve_mb.label: Memory reserve
setting.render_memory_reserve_mb.tip: Memory, in MB, kept free while rendering.
setting.render_motion_collapse_max_growt: Merge two samples when their union grows the box by at most this much.
setting.render_motion_interpolation.tip: Boxes slide between samples at the output frame rate.
setting.render_motion_max_span_seconds.t: The longest gap, in seconds, that a box slides across.
setting.render_motion_size_window_second: Hold each box at its largest size within this many seconds.
setting.render_verify_frame_counts.label: Check chunk frames
setting.render_verify_frame_counts.tip: Check that every render chunk has every frame.
setting.render_worker_mb_per_megapixel.t: Memory each render worker needs per megapixel.
setting.render_workers.label: Render workers
setting.render_workers.tip: Parallel render workers. 0 chooses from the CPU count.
setting.reverse_censor_labels.label: Censored in reverse mode
setting.reverse_censor_labels.tip: Body parts censored inside a shown frame.
setting.reverse_empty_frame.label: Frames with nothing found
setting.reverse_empty_frame.tip: Leave them as they are, or obscure them too.
setting.reverse_enabled.label: Reverse mode
setting.reverse_enabled.tip: Obscure the whole frame except what is detected.
setting.reverse_fade_seconds.label: Fade
setting.reverse_fade_seconds.tip: Seconds to fade between obscured and shown.
setting.reverse_frame_dim.label: Dim
setting.reverse_frame_dim.tip: How much the obscured frame is darkened, from 0 to 1.
setting.reverse_frame_style.label: Frame look
setting.reverse_frame_style.tip: How the rest of the frame is obscured.
setting.reverse_trigger_hold_seconds.tip: Seconds a trigger keeps the frame shown after it is last seen.
setting.reverse_trigger_labels.label: Trigger parts
setting.reverse_trigger_labels.tip: Body parts that switch a frame to shown.
setting.reverse_trigger_min_prob.label: Trigger confidence
setting.reverse_trigger_min_prob.tip: A trigger counts above this score.
setting.reverse_window_style.label: Shown part look
setting.reverse_window_style.tip: How a shown part appears: as it is, or with a soft edge.
setting.rule_duplicate_iou.label: Duplicate overlap
setting.rule_duplicate_iou.tip: A promoted box overlapping an existing one this much is a duplicate.
setting.rule_margin.label: Margin
setting.rule_margin.tip: How much more confident the other label must be.
setting.rule_min_iou.label: Minimum overlap
setting.rule_min_iou.tip: How much the two boxes must overlap.
setting.rule_min_prob.label: Minimum confidence
setting.rule_min_prob.tip: The rule applies above this score.
setting.rule_min_source_overlap.label: Minimum coverage
setting.rule_min_source_overlap.tip: How much of the box the evidence must cover.
setting.rule_overlap.label: Where evidence counts
setting.rule_overlap.tip: Where in the frame the evidence may be.
setting.rule_promote_from.label: Promote from
setting.rule_requires.label: Evidence
setting.rule_requires.tip: What must also be detected for the rule to apply.
setting.rule_requires_label.label: Evidence label
setting.rule_requires_label.tip: The label that counts as evidence.
setting.rule_requires_mode.label: Evidence needed
setting.rule_requires_mode.tip: Any piece of evidence, or all of it.
setting.rule_suppressed_by.label: Suppressed by
setting.rule_suppressed_by.tip: The label that overrides this one.
setting.shot_cut_burst_keep.label: Cut kept from a burst
setting.shot_cut_burst_keep.tip: Keep the first or the last cut of a burst.
setting.shot_cut_burst_max_span.label: Longest burst
setting.shot_cut_burst_max_span.tip: Bursts longer than this many seconds are not merged.
setting.shot_cut_burst_window.label: Cut burst window
setting.shot_cut_burst_window.tip: Cuts closer than this many seconds count as one burst. 0 turns it off.
setting.shot_cut_detection_enabled.label: Find cuts
setting.shot_cut_detection_enabled.tip: Find scene cuts, so tracks stop at them.
setting.shot_cut_threshold.label: Cut sensitivity
setting.size_smoothing.label: Size smoothing
setting.stats_enabled.label: Write run stats
setting.stats_enabled.tip: Record a stats line for each run.
setting.stats_path.label: Stats file
setting.structure_scan_workers.label: Scan workers
setting.structure_scan_workers.tip: Parallel workers for the structure scan. 0 chooses for you.
setting.style_area_safety.label: Style padding
setting.style_area_safety.tip: Grow or shrink the box for this style only.
setting.style_bar_span_extend.label: Bar extension
setting.style_bar_span_extend.tip: How far a bar reaches toward the frame edges, from 0 to 1.
setting.style_bar_thickness.label: Bar thickness
setting.style_bar_thickness.tip: The share of the box height a bar covers.
setting.style_blur_method.label: Blur method
setting.style_blur_method.tip: Gaussian, box, or a cheaper near-Gaussian triple box.
setting.style_color.label: Color
setting.style_color.tip: The fill color, as red, green and blue from 0 to 255.
setting.style_feather.label: Feather
setting.style_merge.label: Overlap handling
setting.style_merge.tip: Overrides the overlap handling for this style.
setting.style_min_dwell_seconds.label: Look hold
setting.style_min_dwell_seconds.tip: Seconds a look is held before a cut may change it.
setting.style_pixel_pattern.label: Pixel pattern
setting.style_shape.label: Style shape
setting.style_shape.tip: Overrides the shape for this style.
setting.style_sticker_dir.label: Sticker folder
setting.style_sticker_images.label: Sticker images
setting.style_sticker_scale.label: Sticker scale
setting.style_sticker_scale.tip: Sticker size relative to the box.
setting.style_strength.label: Strength
setting.style_type.label: Style
setting.style_type.tip: Blur, pixelate, bar, sticker, or debug boxes.
setting.style_weight.label: Weight
setting.style_weight.tip: How often this style is picked, relative to the others.
setting.time_safety.label: Time padding
setting.time_safety.tip: Seconds of extra cover before and after each appearance.
setting.track_max_gap.label: Track memory
setting.track_max_gap.tip: Seconds a track may go undetected before it ends.
setting.tray_icon_shown.label: Show the tray icon
setting.tray_icon_shown.tip: Keep an icon in the system tray while the app is open. While a job runs in the background, it is shown either way.
setting.type_default_shapes.label: Shape per style
setting.type_default_shapes.tip: The shape a style type uses when it sets none.
setting.video_censor_fps.label: Sample rate
setting.video_censor_fps.tip: Frames per second checked for body parts. Higher is slower and catches more.
